verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs say users can click "Add custom integration" and point the AI Assistant at any MCP server, including one they build themselves. The pricing page also lists MCP as an integration path for the AI, and examples such as GitHub issue management show the assistant using connected tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom MCP servers work as described, and detailed docs on supported transports, authentication and tool-permission controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: You can connect virtually any application through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Just click "Add custom integration" and point to an MCP server of your choice — or even create your own.
Connect the AI with your favorite apps and services for enhanced productivity workflows through built-in integrations or MCP
